section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor analysis results for the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) conducted on a female sample. Parallel analysis indicated that two factors should be retained: a General Body Appreciation factor (explaining 51.2% of variance, α = .93) and an adaptive Body Image Investment factor (explaining 14.2% of variance, α = .72), which were moderately correlated (r = .37).
